_about: Verified uniform facts. check-uniform-claims.mjs fails if a post contradicts one. Add a fact only with a source (game photo or official). namesOnBack: true = game jerseys carry player names; false = they do not; 'home-only-none' = no names at home, names on road.

facts.source: Game photos 2025 (ROBERTS 77 crimson, SIMPSON 15 white); names since 1981 apart from Ray Perkins break. Reader correction 2026-10-09.
Names returned to home and road in 2007 after 2005-06 nameless seasons.
Names removed 2015 (gopsusports.com 2015-07-16); 2025 game photos bare numbers.
Never worn names, home or road.
No names on home whites; road grays carry names.
